baseline_rest_definition: 200 ms grounded below registered movement deadband. Two independent five-strike rounds per neural seed/type; no neural reset within a round. Neural seed reused, environment round stream recorded. Physical escape (miss) and neural onset probability are distinct.

selection: No selection unless all declared targets pass. No grid expansion or result-dependent target changes.
